options.name: --release
options.description: optimized, debug info stripped

options.name: --shape
options.description:
bundles a runtime -- not implemented (#6262)
native binary; --aot is sugar for this
--standalone/--aot are sugar for the matching --shape)
lyric build   --release --aot [<source.l>] [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--rid <rid>] [-o <bin>]
(self-contained native binary; no source: builds the discovered project.
NOTE: --release alone no longer implies AOT -- it selects the profile only)
lyric check   [<source.l>...] [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--target dotnet|jvm]
(type-check without producing a usable output artifact)
lyric clean   [<dir>] [--manifest <lyric.toml>]
(remove bin/, .lyric-run/, .lyric-test/, .lyric-bench/, .lyric-check/, .lyric-release/)
lyric bindgen <header.h> --package <Name> --allow <file> [-o <out.l>] [--library <name>] [-I <dir>]... [--clang-arg <arg>]... [--long-bits 32|64] [--check]
(generate native FFI bindings from a C header with clang; --check fails if -o is out of date)
lyric restore [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--locked]
lyric update  [--manifest <lyric.toml>]
(re-resolve all deps to latest compatible versions and rewrite lyric.lock)
lyric upgrade [--nuget | --dotnet-tool] [--github] [--version <version>] [--dir <dir>] [--dry-run]
(self-upgrade the lyric CLI to the latest or specific version)
lyric deps    [--manifest <lyric.toml>]
(print the resolved dependency tree from lyric.lock)
lyric add     <name>[@<version>] [--path <dir>] [--git <url> [--tag|--rev|--branch <ref>]]
[--nuget] [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--no-restore]
(adds/updates a dependency in [dependencies] (or [nuget]) and restores)
lyric remove  <name> [--nuget] [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--no-restore]
(removes a dependency from [dependencies] (or [nuget]) and restores)
lyric publish [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--dll <path>] [-o <dir>] [--registry <url>] [--api-key <key>]
lyric search  <term>
lyric version [--manifest <lyric.toml>]
(print the current package version)
lyric version --set <semver> [--manifest <lyric.toml>]
(update [package].version in lyric.toml)
lyric version --workspace [--set <semver>]
(print or update versions for all workspace members; warns on misalignment)
